description: Returns every slide section (problem, team, traction, ask and the rest) with its id, name, a one-line meaning, how many slide images it has and the share of decks that include it. Call it first to get the section ids that search_slides takes. For numbers to compare a deck against, such as median slide count or where each section first appears, call section_benchmarks instead. Each item has id, name, about, slides_with_image and share_of_decks (0 to 1, among decks with a full slide list).
name: list_sections
title: List slide sections
